about_the_game:
A Tower Defense Game That Emphasizes Strategy and Skill

  • In this game, you can place towers anywhere on the map—but how do you place them for maximum efficiency? Should you prioritize resource towers to build up your economy, or defense towers to survive immediate threats? When’s the right moment to cast a spell? Every decision matters.

  • Tower placement follows real physics—use new towers to nudge or reposition earlier ones. Adapt your strategy on the fly as the battlefield evolves!

Distinct Biome-Themed Maps

The free demo includes 2 chapters, with the full version planned to have 5, each featuring unique terrain and environmental mechanics.For example, in the snowy levels, you'll need to build campfires—structures outside warm zones will freeze, slowing their attack and resource desert maps, towers near each other will heat up—at heat level 3, they'll attack faster but also take more damage. High risk, high reward!

Creative & Challenging Level Design

 In addition to classic tower defense gameplay, the game features a variety of unique strategy modes for you to enjoy.Try the Night Raid Mode, where crystals drop randomly in the dark, or Deployment Mode, which gives you 2000 crystals at the start to freely build and position your towers however you like.Dive into the strategic fun of tower defense—more exciting and inventive modes will be added in the full release!

Diverse & Strategic Build Options

  • The demo features 10+ unique tower types designed to counter different enemy threats. Freeze enemies with Ice Towers, snipe ranged units using Scatter Crossbows, or bring down flying foes with Capture Towers.Combine these with dozens of powerful Runes to boost your towers with special effects and stats.

  • In addition to towers, you can equip Spell Towers to unleash devastating one-time abilities. Fireball instantly wipes out groups of orcs, while Fog reduces the range of enemy archers.With so many strategic combinations, there's no single way to win—find your own path to victory!
